risks.title: Decline in natural gas production or demand
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described with high-impact language: 'could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations'. It affects the core of DTM's business model. Dependence on natural gas volumes in operating areas, potential competition from renewable energy, and regulatory constraints amplify its severity. Industrials category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Dependence on a key customer
risks.score_rationale: Structural customer concentration risk. Although not precisely quantified in the provided excerpt, midstream industry practices expose companies to significant revenue concentration. Potential impact on cash flow stability, but mitigated by customer diversification and documented long-term contracts.

risks.title: Failure to renew long-term contracts
risks.score_rationale: The document emphasizes that firm contracts ensure revenue stability. The risk of non-renewal is implicit in the business model and could 'adversely affect the stability of our cash flows'. Language is moderate to strong, but less critical than a direct existential risk.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party interconnections
risks.score_rationale: The natural gas network structure requires interconnections with third parties. The document implies that unavailability of critical third-party assets could 'could materially adversely affect'. Loss of control over critical interconnection assets increases severity. Industrials category relevant for operational infrastructure.

risks.title: Major operational risks (accidents, weather, cybersecurity)
risks.score_rationale: Critical energy infrastructure exposed to multiple operational risks: pipeline ruptures, explosions, extreme weather, cyberattacks. Very strong language implied by the nature of the industry: potential for 'loss of human life, substantial financial losses'. Existential risk to operations and physical asset integrity. Industrials category as it covers all physical assets.

risks.title: Risks related to joint ventures and equity investments
risks.score_rationale: DTM holds equity method investments in pipeline projects (Millennium, NEXUS). The text mentions exposure to partner credit risks, lack of control, and potential disagreements. Significant operational and financial impact, but not existential at the group level.

risks.title: Environmental and political opposition to project developments
risks.score_rationale: Risk of opposition from environmental or local groups is inherent in the natural gas industry. The sector faces regulatory delays and potential litigation that could 'prevent, disrupt or delay' developments. Impact on future project growth, hence high severity. Reputation category as it relates to public perception and climate issues.

ai_positioning.summary: DTM does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
